mutation: One extra whitelist branch is injected into the pass-through section so the entire admin form-handler tree '/goform/' is treated as public. A protected /goform/* config action now hits the early pass-through return BEFORE the login-session check, so state-changing admin actions are served to an unauthenticated request.
flaw_line: if (strncmp(url, "/goform/", 8) == 0) return 0;  /* injected pass-through for the whole admin form tree */
why: R7WebsSecurityHandler is the goahead security handler registered first in initWebs @0x434504; it whitelists public URLs (early return = served with no auth) and, for protected paths, serves only if the request's session id is a stored authenticated session in loginUserInfo[], otherwise redirects to login. Whitelisting the '/goform/' tree short-circuits the session check for admin config actions -> CWE-306 unauth access to protected functions.
